scope: Computer Control Phase 9C1 native AppKit menu bar ownership and Accessibility topology discovery, corrected readiness harness
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit application menu bar via registered Provider and native Accessibility

historicalEvidence.s01Cause: readiness harness checked a nonexistent ready.running field even though ensureApplicationReady returned state READY and verified true; topology probe was not reached

safetyBoundary.addressing: registered application Provider only for fixture ownership; native menu bar read from the exact Provider process AX application object
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: registered Provider fixture readiness is accepted only from ensureApplicationReady state READY with verified true
resolved menu bar has role AXMenuBar
the deterministic RumiAI Actions top-level menu marker is present
complete read-only topology JSON is recorded including roles, titles/values/descriptions/identifiers, enabled state, advertised actions and child counts
visibility of Alpha Action, Disabled Action and Nested Action while the menu is closed is recorded diagnostically rather than assumed
no menu is opened and no action is performed during discovery
